headline.purpose: The single hero number or word per screen (calories remaining, modal titles).

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows, stat captions, nav labels.

shadows.name: structural-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates fixed header/bottom nav from scrolling content.

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts modals and sheets above the blurred backdrop.

shadows.name: reward-glow-mint
shadows.purpose: Earned glow on the protein progress fill only.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: active:scale press feedback on buttons and nav icons.

motion.name: duration-progress
motion.purpose: Calorie ring and protein bar fill animations, eased out.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ember-orange CTA with reward glow and press feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d97757; color: #ffffff; padding: 20px 24px; border-radius: 24px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; border: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(217,119,87,0.2); transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f8dbc8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Solid alert-red action for destructive confirmations only.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #ef4444; color: #ffffff; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 16px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(239,68,68,0.2); transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Default tonal card used for dashboard sections and list rows.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #161616; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-label { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a1a1aa; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-value { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #40b3a2; margin: 0; } .ds-card-value span { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #a1a1aa; letter-spacing: normal; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Pill-wrapped password/text field with border-only focus signal.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { background: #1e1e1e; border: 2px solid rgba(51,51,51,0.2); border-radius: 24px; padding: 4px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #d97757; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #f9f7f2; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; padding: 16px 20px; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Fixed four-item bottom nav with a centered floating add button.
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: #121212; border-top: 1px solid #262626; box-shadow: 0 -1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); padding: 12px 8px 32px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: none; border: none; color: #a1a1aa; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #d97757; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.9); } .ds-fab { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #d97757; border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(217,119,87,0.2); transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-fab:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-fab:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

narrative.overview:
The app is a dark, low-glare instrument you check between bites: near-black surfaces that recede, so the two accent hues — ember orange and mint teal — carry all the meaning. It reads energetic and motivating rather than clinical: numbers count down with weight (font-black, tight tracking), progress rings animate with real ease, and quick-log actions resolve with a visible, colored success state. This is a coach in your pocket, not a spreadsheet.

The system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS/AI look: no cream or beige surfaces, no gradient text, no identical icon-card grids, no tiny uppercase eyebrows stacked above every section. It also rejects gamified fitness-app kitsch — no badges, no streak decoration, no mascots — and rejects dense enterprise analytics: this is a single-user daily-glance tool, so one hero number always leads.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal surfaces (background → surface → surface-bright) carry depth; color is reserved for meaning, not decoration.
Ember orange (#d97757) = calories/primary action. Mint teal (#40b3a2) = protein/secondary metric. The two never swap roles.
Headline numbers are heavy and tight (font-black, negative tracking) — the app's most-viewed digits get the most visual weight.
Uppercase, widely-tracked micro-labels (9-10px) caption every stat; body copy stays sentence case.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Only two saturated hues exist in this system: ember orange for calories, mint teal for protein. Any new metric gets a neutral treatment before a third accent color is even considered.

rules.name: The Error Is Red Rule
rules.body: #ef4444 is reserved exclusively for destructive actions (delete confirmations and their icons). It never doubles as a generic accent, and no longer covers the over-goal ring.

rules.name: The Coach, Not Cop Rule
rules.body: Going over a calorie goal is a nudge, not a violation: the ring switches to Coach Amber (#ca8a04), never destructive red. Red is reserved for the one place data actually gets destroyed.

rules.name: The One Hero Rule
rules.body: Exactly one number per screen renders at Headline weight and size. Every other stat is Body or Label.

rules.name: The Earned Glow Rule
rules.body: Colored glow only appears on things currently succeeding or asking for action — never as ambient card decoration. If nothing is being celebrated, the surface stays flat.

dos: Do keep exactly two accent hues — ember orange for calories, mint teal for protein — and route any new metric through neutral tones first.
Do lead every screen with one Headline-weight number; everything else is Body or Label.
Do reserve colored glow/shadow for things currently succeeding — never as ambient card decoration.
Do use large, progressive corner radii (16–40px) and firm active:scale-95 press feedback so the UI feels tactile and confident.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every animated element and maintain 4.5:1 text contrast against #0a0a0a/#121212.
donts: Don't introduce cream, beige, or any light warm-neutral body background — this system is true-black-anchored, full stop.
Don't use gradient text, tiny uppercase eyebrows stacked above every section, or identical icon-card grids.
Don't add badges, streaks-as-decoration, or mascot illustrations.
Don't pair a 1px border with a soft wide (≥16px blur) drop shadow on the same element.
Don't let a third saturated accent color creep in for a new metric or feature; extend the neutral ramp instead.
Don't signal over-goal/under-goal with color alone — always pair with an icon or text label.
